name: multilanetesting
description: Multi-lane testing framework — web/DOM, API contract, WS contract, and screen-driver lanes.

scripts.test:unit: node --test packages/core/test/*.test.mjs packages/cli/test/*.test.mjs packages/http/test/*.test.mjs packages/stomp/test/*.test.mjs packages/screen/test/*.test.mjs packages/authoring-screen/test/*.test.mjs packages/snmp-model/test/*.test.mjs packages/snmp-runtime/test/*.test.mjs packages/snmp-adapter-selection/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.validate: npm run check:no-runtime-ai && npm run check:robot-contract && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit
